walk_speed_m_per_min.citation: Bohannon RW (1997) Comfortable and maximum walking speed of adults aged 20-79 years: reference values and determinants, Age and Ageing 26(1):15-19 (abstract): mean comfortable gait speed 127.2 cm/s (women in their seventies) to 146.2 cm/s (men in their forties), n = 230 healthy volunteers; maximum 174.9 to 253.3 cm/s.
walk_speed_m_per_min.note: Healthy adults over a 7.62 m walkway, not staff in a hospital corridor; working-age adults sit near 80-88 m/min. Hurrying staff can reach 105-150 m/min (the maximum-speed figures).

fixed_cost_per_hour.citation: Calibrated, split assumed: overhead allocated to the Emergency cost centre = Worksheet B Part I line 91 column 26 minus Worksheet A line 91 column 7 = 37834167 usd/year (CMS HCRIS hospital cost report (form CMS-2552-10), FY2024 file, report 811005 for CCN 310038, fiscal year 01/01/2024-12/31/2024), spread over the modelled ED spaces {'triage': 3, 'treatment_bay': 68, 'resus_bay': 6, 'fast_track': 10, 'peds_ed': 17, 'results_waiting': 1} for 8784 hours using the Wave 0 relative weights (this space type 0.4167); scale factor 15.92
fixed_cost_per_hour.note: The annual total is measured; how it divides between space types is assumed, hence the 'assumed' tag. Overhead includes employee-benefit, administration, plant and housekeeping allocations and so overlaps staff.benefits_load. ED staff salaries are NOT included (staff are costed by wage). Wave 0 placeholder was 0.4167.
